payload.title: The shared AuditLogInterceptor redacts arguments only by a fixed key-name list, so the audited createEmployee, updateEmployee and createPayroll mutations store base salary, IBAN and bank details and national ID verbatim in hr-service audit metadata
evidence: libs/backend-common/src/audit/audit-log.interceptor.ts:31-42 (SENSITIVE_KEYS has no salary, iban, bank or nationalId key)
libs/backend-common/src/audit/audit-log.interceptor.ts:429 (the lower-cased key is matched against camelCase entries, so accessToken, refreshToken and creditCard never match)
libs/backend-common/src/audit/audit-log.interceptor.ts:220-227 (all other GraphQL args are stored as metadata.args)
apps/hr-service/src/app.module.ts:410-414 (the interceptor is registered globally in hr-service)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/dto/create-employee.input.ts:174 (nationalId; baseSalary at :210 and bankDetails with iban at :223 sit on the same audited input)
payload.rule_violated: D6 (salary visible only inside HR) and the interceptor's own contract that sensitive values never reach the audit trail.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-07, release R4.
